description: Splits a dataset folder into train / valid / test in the layout YOLO training expects, redoing any existing split. Detection or segmentation datasets (images with YOLO .txt labels) get train|valid|test/images and /labels plus data.yaml; classification datasets (one folder per class) get train|val|test/<class>/, split class by class. Wire its dataset output to Model Training's dataset input; for detection or segmentation, set Model Training's data file to data.yaml.

inputs.name: dataset
inputs.description: The dataset to split: e.g. Annotations to YOLO Dataset's output, a folder of images with .txt labels beside them, or one folder per class.

outputs.name: dataset
outputs.description: The split dataset folder, ready for Model Training.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: Images per split, classes, and labels per class (or images per class and split, for classification).

dataset_type.description: 'detect' for images with YOLO .txt labels (detection or segmentation), 'classify' for one folder per class. 'auto' picks 'detect' when any label file exists.

test_split.description: Fraction of images for test (0–1). 0 for no test split. Validation and test together must stay below 1.

seed.description: Random seed, so the same dataset always splits the same way.

drop_unlabeled.description: Detection only: leave out images with no label file. Off by default: they're kept as background images with an empty label.

exec_queue.description: Scheduler queue. This is a CPU-only job, so it defaults to a CPU queue (overrides the run-level queue).

appArgs.name: tool
appArgs.description: The shared wf-utils container runs several small tools; this picks which one (jobs/wf_utils/).
